notes:
Scope read: all non-test code of the six files (about 3,400 of 5,044 lines; the rest are test modules). Nothing was edited and cargo was not run. Call-site counts are greps of apps/agents-window/src, excluding the definition; for private helpers they are calls inside their own file. Counts that include test callers are broken down in the recommendation text.

Module layout and hidden coupling
- git_panel.rs is a child module of view.rs (`mod git_panel;` at view.rs:53) and starts with `use super::*`. It depends on private view.rs helpers that are outside this area: label (view.rs:649, 14px theme::UI_FONT_SIZE default, always overridden here), mono (:656), hinted_icon_button (:710), divider (:762), shorten (:768), pane_empty_state (:1991, wraps limn Empty compact with palette.surface = PANEL), pane_loading_state (:2006, bordered PANEL card radius 10, padding 16, height 250, Skeletons). Whoever owns the view.rs area must migrate these together with git_panel.
- environment_selectors_ui.rs takes `ComposerProps` from composer_ui.rs and is re-exported by it (composer_ui.rs:29); environment_ui imports the selectors back through composer_ui. Dropdown ids are shared between composer and environment card (`composer_project_*`, `composer_branch_*`), and `environment_ui::local_menu` and `environment_selectors_ui::local_selector` emit the same action ids (`environment_worktree_select:{rev}:{i}`, `environment_choose_project`, `environment_copy_path`, `environment_local_files`, `environment_git_open_worktree`) from two separately written entry lists.
- environment_ui::build uses `crate::settings_ui::control_palette()` for the two Outline git buttons (cross-area palette).
- sidebar_chrome.rs (INSET 6, GAP 6, HEADER_HEIGHT 26, NAV_ROW_HEIGHT 28, TOOL_SIZE = ControlSize::Dense 24, header/title/tool) and dock_tab_ui.rs (HEADER_HEIGHT 32, TOOL_SIZE 24) supply the geometry constants for git_panel and files_panel_ui. They are openADE files holding generic density tokens.
- Action ids double as tooltip ids and hover-surface ids (`{action}:surface` in git_panel.rs:242); the controller matches on these strings, so component swaps must keep ids byte-identical.

Palettes and colors defined locally
- No ComponentPalette is constructed field-by-field in this area, but five different palette sources are mixed, often in the same view: theme::component_palette() (canvas), theme::menu_palette(), theme::interactive_palette() via theme::interactive_surface, theme::action_palette(surface, FOREGROUND) with surface = CARD / SIDEBAR / BACKGROUND / the caller's surface, and settings_ui::control_palette(). One local mutation: `search_palette.raised = theme::INPUT` (environment_selectors_ui.rs:315-316).
- The real rule being encoded is 'hover is relative to the surface the control sits on' (theme::hover_for = +8 per channel; INPUT on BACKGROUND/PANEL/transparent). limn needs that as a palette derivation, otherwise every wrapper here stays.
- Local color constants: SELECTOR_INK, SELECTOR_MUTED (environment_selectors_ui.rs:11-12). Local geometry constants: MODEL_MENU_SCROLL_GUTTER, git_panel CHANGE_ROW_HEIGHT / CHANGE_ACTION_SIZE / SCROLL_RAIL_WIDTH 14, files_panel ROW_HEIGHT 24 / TOOL_SIZE / INSET 8.
- theme:: roles used: BACKGROUND, SIDEBAR, PANEL, CARD, INPUT, BORDER, TREE_GUIDE, FOREGROUND, FOREGROUND_SUBTLE, MENU_MUTED, ICON_PRIMARY, DESTRUCTIVE, DIFF_ADDED, DIFF_REMOVED (plus SELECTED, MENU_SURFACE, MENU_HOVER through the palettes). CARD, SIDEBAR and INPUT are the same RGB (43,43,43) today, which hides which role each call really means.
- environment_git_ui.rs:345 draws a section rule in TREE_GUIDE (72,72,72) while every other rule uses BORDER (46,46,46): visible inconsistency, flag to the owner rather than silently unify.

Tests that pin geometry or structure
- In-file test modules (skipped for inventory, but they constrain the migration): git_panel.rs (about 18 geometric assertions: narrow rows prioritise the basename, stage/unstage tooltip follows the real button hover, sidebar hover visibility, GitHub icon centered in the repository button, diff header breadcrumb/toolbar, 10,000-row virtualization, plus an exported visual review), files_panel_ui.rs (tool centering, disclosure before artwork, tooltip content, virtualization of thousands of rows), environment_git_ui.rs (compact commit form keeps primary/secondary actions and remote fields separate; exported visual review), environment_selectors_ui.rs (popup anchor, snapshot indices, footer), environment_ui.rs (unique button ids, labels present).
- External test files touching this area: environment_layout_tests.rs (layout numbers 616 / 280..380 / heights), git_panel_visual_tests.rs, dock_visual_tests.rs (calls environment_ui::panel), dock_integration_tests.rs, hover_surface_tests.rs (shared hover surface of the change row), file_icon_integration_tests.rs, home_visual_tests.rs.
- git_panel::detail_content has no production caller; it exists for tests.

Things that will not look identical if swapped naively
- limn ActionRow is title 12 / subtitle 11 / padding 10; openADE rows are title 12-12.5 / subtitle 10-10.5 / padding 4-6 and heights 28-48. The list row in limn must adopt the openADE densities.
- Notices are bare text; limn Alert would add icon and frame.
- project_actions_ui::editor uses raw Element::text_input (radius 6, padding 7, heights 32/34, monospace command) instead of TextField.
- files_panel empty state is hand-built text + ghost button, while git_panel uses limn Empty through pane_empty_state: candidates to unify, but it changes the files empty state.
- detail_view estimates text width as chars x 7.8 px to decide whether stats fit; a limn header with real measurement will shift the breakpoint slightly.
- Unstage is a text Button with the glyph '−'; stage is an IconButton.

Size of the change for this area
- About 55 UI-building functions. Roughly 25 are generic and would be deleted or become one-line limn calls; about 12 are thin app wrappers; about 18 are domain compositions that stay but get rewritten on top of new components.
- New limn pieces needed, in order of leverage: ListRow (9 hand-written variants here), PanelHeader plus tool icon button (6 + 5), text roles/tokens, InlineStatus (17), searchable SelectMenu with two-line items and states, SectionHeader, Separator, DiffStat, Field, IconLabel/IconCount, ValueRow with count Chip, Card, surface-relative palette derivation, and small option gaps (mini button size, bare icon button, monospace TextField, ScrollArea fade/rail).
- Estimated effect on the area: non-test code drops from about 3,400 lines to roughly 2,000-2,300; most of the risk is in git_panel.rs (shared hover surface, virtualization, pinned tests) and the selectors (focus/anchor behaviour). environment_ui.rs, environment_git_ui.rs and project_actions_ui.rs are mechanical once ListRow, PanelHeader and text roles exist.

Not verified: I did not run the tests or render anything, so 'pixel-equal' claims about limn Button/TextField versus the hand-built triggers are from reading the numbers only; limn component internals were sampled (preferences.rs, ButtonSize, ControlSize, SelectorSizing), not read in full.
